name: ls
longDesc: The ls command lists files and directories within the file system. By default, it excludes hidden files and prints only the names. Flags can reveal permissions, sizes, and hidden items.

flags.description: Use a long listing format showing permissions, owner, and size
Do not ignore entries starting with . (hidden files)

examples.description: List visible files in current directory
List all files (including hidden) in detailed format

name: cd
longDesc: The cd command changes the current working directory in your terminal session.

name: pwd
longDesc: Displays the full absolute path to the current working directory.

name: clear
longDesc: Clears your screen if this is possible, including its scrollback buffer.
